description: First-ever compile+run of F0805A (solutions/08-05/f0805as.rpgle, the free-form DOW/IF rewrite of JU0300's control-level processing). Self-contained: recompiles JU0300 (src/legacy/qrpgsrc/ju0300.rpg, unmodified) and re-runs it in the SAME connection as F0805A, both with *LDA bytes 11-16 (FTOK) cleared to blank first, so the two printed reports can be diffed against each other from this ONE connection's own 'run' section text, without depending on state left by any earlier connection (same self-containment convention as part05-ju0900c-baseline/part05-13-tickets). JU0300's own output should be byte-for-byte identical to verify/part08-05-legacy-baseline/expected/golden-master.md's JU0300 section (same unmodified program, same clean TXRESET'd data, same FTOK-blank state) - if it is not, something about this library's current state has drifted since that baseline was captured, and F0805A's own diff should not be trusted until that is understood first. F0805A has never been compiled before this connection - see its own header for the design rationale (DTAARA+IN for the FTOK filter, %XFOOT with the ported IX<>49 guard, empirically-derived column positions). RUNTXRESET runs first (same defensive reasoning as part08-05-legacy-baseline and part05-13-tickets: this library is shared across many manifests' connections, and this connection's own comparison needs the true db/data/load_v1.sql seed state). Both CRTxxxPGM steps DLTPGM first (MONMSG CPF0000) before REPLACE(*YES), same reasoning as part08-05-legacy-baseline (a compile failure then leaves the object MISSING rather than silently falling back to a stale object). No collect steps: this manifest's whole purpose is the two programs' own printed QSYSPRT text in the 'run' section, which the harness already captures directly (part06-0103-freeform's confirmed finding) - reading and diffing that text happens outside the harness, by hand, after this connection.

steps.label: CPJU03
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/JU0300)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTRPGPGM PGM(&LIB/JU0300) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGSRC) SRCMBR(JU0300) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPF0805A
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/F0805A)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTBNDRPG PGM(&LIB/F0805A) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(F0805A) DFTACTGRP(*NO) ACTGRP(*NEW) REPLACE(*YES)
